note: Seed dataset for the Voyet itinerary engine. Ratings/review counts are illustrative seed values for the demo; replace with live Google Places API data before launch. icons must exist in the front-end ICONS map; colors in ACS; tags in TAGMETA.

venues.name: National Air and Space Museum
venues.why: Rockets, jets, and the Moon — one of the most popular museums anywhere, and free.

hl.stroller: Wide galleries and elevators; fully stroller-friendly.
hl.indoor: All-indoor and huge — easy to escape heat or rain.
hl.free: Free entry (timed passes in peak season).

venues.name: National Museum of Natural History
venues.why: Dinosaurs, the Hope Diamond, and a live butterfly pavilion — free and fully indoor.

hl.stroller: Elevators throughout; an easy push between halls.
hl.indoor: A reliable all-weather morning on the Mall.
hl.free: Free admission to the whole museum.

venues.name: Smithsonian's National Zoo
venues.why: Free to enter, home to giant pandas and a great ape trail, with paved, stroller-easy paths.

hl.stroller: Paved main loop — note it's a gentle hill at the far end.
hl.free: Free admission; you only pay for parking.
hl.outdoor: Lots of open-air space between habitats.

venues.name: National Mall
venues.why: Wide-open lawns connecting the monuments — a flat, free stroller stroll past the icons.

hl.stroller: Long, level paths the length of the Mall.
hl.naptimed: An easy, scenic stroll for the nap window.
hl.free: All free — picnic on the grass between sights.

venues.name: National Museum of American History
venues.why: The original Star-Spangled Banner plus a hands-on Wonderplace for the youngest visitors.

hl.indoor: Another free indoor option steps away on the Mall.
hl.free: Free entry, including the kids' Wonderplace.

venues.name: United States Botanic Garden
venues.why: A free, warm indoor jungle at the foot of the Capitol — calm, green, and stroller-smooth.

hl.indoor: Warm and quiet — a lovely slow-down spot.

venues.name: Tidal Basin
venues.why: A flat waterside loop past the Jefferson Memorial — calm, scenic, and free (paddle boats optional).

hl.stroller: Level path right around the water.
hl.naptimed: The quiet basin loop is a dependable nap walk.
hl.free: Free to stroll; paddle boats are a small add-on.

venues.name: International Spy Museum
venues.why: A hands-on spy adventure with missions and gadgets — great for older kids, fully indoor.

hl.stroller: Elevators between floors keep it stroller-friendly.
hl.indoor: A paid indoor option when you want a change from the Smithsonians.

venues.name: &pizza
venues.why: Fast build-your-own pizzas — let kids pick their toppings and you're back on the Mall quickly.

hl.kidmenu: Kids design a simple cheese pie of their own.
hl.indoor: A quick indoor refuel near the museums.

venues.name: Shake Shack — Dupont Circle
venues.why: Burgers, a kids' menu, and high chairs — a dependable, low-stress lunch.

hl.kidmenu: Kid-sized burgers and shakes; high chairs ready.
hl.indoor: Easy indoor seating near the circle.

venues.name: Old Ebbitt Grill
venues.why: A historic tavern near the White House with a children's menu and roomy booths.

hl.kidmenu: A proper kids' menu and high chairs.
hl.indoor: Classic indoor booths for a sit-down midday.

hotels.name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Washington DC Convention Center
hotels.why: Two-room suites, a made-to-order breakfast, and an indoor pool — a comfortable, walkable base near a Metro stop.

hotels.name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill
hotels.why: A short walk to the Capitol and the Mall, with an indoor pool and easy access to Union Station and the Metro.

hotels.name: Residence Inn Washington Downtown
hotels.why: Suites with full kitchens and free breakfast — ideal for longer stays with little ones.

hotels.name: Marriott Marquis Washington DC
hotels.why: A large, modern hotel with plenty of on-site dining for nights you don't want to wander far.
